title: Welcome to The Guest House
subtitle: Rumi, Shams and the stories of old Persia, from the original Persian
yt_title: Welcome to The Guest House | Rumi from the Original Persian
intro: Here we read Rumi, Shams, and the great storytellers of old Persia, from the original Persian.
Real verses, honest translations, and what they mean.

poems.name: The Guest House

lines.fa: هست مهمان‌خانه این تن ای جوان
lines.en: This body is a guest house, young friend:

lines.fa: هر صباحی ضیف نو آید دوان
lines.en: every morning a new guest comes running.

tafsir: This is the passage that gave our channel its name.
Whatever arrives in you today is a guest. And guests leave.

outro: Every week: new verses of Rumi, and true stories from Beyhaqi's thousand year old history.
